messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — planning a midnight standby slot rotation for the uk-west GPU pool tonight 00:30–01:30 UTC. Goal is to free up 4 A100s for a short demo burst. Can infra confirm capacity/eviction risk? Also need finance to confirm vendor PO release for VendorX invoice.
ryan: Is this going to impact the LLM perf canary? We have a low-traffic canary running around 00:45 UTC.
sophia: If we shrink the standby by 4 it should be fine as long as canary stays pinned to its AZ. I'll pin the canary to uk-west1-a and monitor.
opsbot: Booking created: standby-rotation-1768104321. Reserved window 00:30–01:30 UTC. Owners: @maya, @ryan. Auto-notify to oncall if preemptible eviction > 10%.
maya: TY opsbot. @linda any chance finance can pre-approve PO or tell me what info you need? VendorX needs a PO ref to release the racks.
linda: Need vendor invoice draft or expected amount. Also need the project code and an estimate line item to attach. How much are we committing for the short burst? Is this covered under the monthly reserved pool or a separate spot invoice?
ryan: It's a short-term swap; vendor quoted ~£3,600 for the overnight borrow (4x A100 for 1h plus transport/ops). Project code RED-INF-DEMO. I can attach a screenshot of their email.
sophia: Confirming canary pinning now. Also creating a tiny smoke test to run at 00:40 to validate KV cache warmup post-swap.
maya: Adding the terraform PR that will temporarily reassign the standby slice: https://git.redwood/infra/terraform/PR-4721 — it toggles standby_count from 12 -> 8 in uk-west pool. @ops please review for DRY_RUN risk.
opsbot: Terraform plan (DRY_RUN) for PR-4721 passed in staging. Diff summary:
```
module.pool.count: 12 -> 8
module.pool.tags += ["rotation-1768104321"]
``` 
No destructive changes beyond scale down.
linda: OK if invoice is ~£3.6k we can do a one-off PO. @maya please upload vendor email + invoice draft to /finance/approvals and I'll route it. Also confirm vendor legal name and VAT number.
maya: Vendor legal: VendorX Ltd, VAT GB123456789. Uploading docs now.
finance-bot: Invoice hold created: INV-PREAPPR-1768104321. Approver queue: linda -> finance-ops. Status: pending docs.
ryan: Heads-up for oncall: if eviction spikes during rotation, fallback policy is automatic spill to h100-pool in eu-west, but that adds 40ms median tail. Flagging so product is aware.
sophia: Noted. I'll log a brief incident channel note if we hit >5% error increase during smoke test.
maya: Thanks. Ops — can you confirm a final ACK by 00:10 UTC? I'll proceed with upload and vendor ping.
opsbot: ACK recorded by opsbot at 1768105400. Standby rotation scheduled. Will escalate to oncall automatically if plan fails. 
linda: ACK finance pre-approval pending doc upload. I'll approve asap once files are in.
maya: Uploaded. Thanks all — will report back after 01:00 with final status and any surprises. :thumbsup:
